Kit summary

Intense AttackBasic
Deals 3 stages of 140% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. If self HP is below 50%, additionally grants self 40% Leech. If not, increases self Turn Meter by 10%.
PrestigeActive
Deals 200% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 85% chance to inflict [Horrify] for 1 turn and a 85% chance to inflict [Freeze] for 1 turn.
TriumphPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Ulcaster gains 1 layer of [Soul of Glory] whenever an enemy dies, each of which increases self DMG dealt by 40% and Effect Hit by 40%, up to 4 layers. Grants [The Night King's Will] and 1 layer of [Soul of Glory] on the ally with the highest ATK when Ulcaster or the ally with [The Night King's Will] dies, and grants 1 more layer of [Soul of Glory] on the ally for every enemy they kill. Only up to 1 ally on the battlefield could have [The Night King's Will]. Ulcaster will reclaim the [Soul of Glory] and [The Night King's Will] from the ally with [The Night King's Will] when he is revived.
Eternal Night Scepter Lv.1Grants self [DMG Immunity] and immunity to Turn Meter reduction effects for 1 turn if self HP is below 50% after taking Direct DMG. This skill can only be triggered up to once every 2 turns. When the ally with [The Night King's Will] kills any enemy after Ulcaster dies, Ulcaster will be revived with 30% of Max HP.
Eternal Night Scepter Lv.3Ulcaster gains 1 more action turn when he inflicts a kill.
ReignActiveExclusive Lv.2
Increases self ATK by 40% for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 200% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 85% chance to reduce their DEF by 60% for 2 turns and a 85% chance to reduce their Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Eternal Night Scepter Lv.2Reign increases all allies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns.
